checks: Unconfigured backend blocks login; configured-but-not-ready stays honest. Opening/cancelling/polling the Discord browser flow is not authentication. Only a verified native identity unlocks server selection. No password/webhook fields.
Server/channel selection uses actual setup. Opening bot installation does not claim readiness. Manager role change requires a concrete role confirmation and displays the saved role.
Stale poll results stay explicitly marked as saved/outdated. updatedAt labels the result timestamp; pollCheckedAt is only labelled as the last check. Existing counts and unknown values are preserved.

All five categories prepare and publish their fixed audience. Only Stream and Umfrage contain polls, Stream keeps the three attendance answers. Real raw poll counts render 7 / 0 / unknown, with no fabricated zero.
The confirmation remains bound to the prepared server/channel even if Core selection changes before submit; the sent operation retains its original channel.

Image replacement cancellation keeps the preview. Two-message confirmation stays clear at 320/390. A confirmed image plus failed poll offers image opening and poll-only retry using the same operation ID, without another upload or deletion.
Unknown poll delivery has an explicit poll-only retry warning. Cancelling sends nothing; local completion preserves the confirmed image and never calls Discord.

The real event composer rejects an end before its start. Confirmation includes local timezone, server and location/link. The scheduled_event operation has no channel/category/ping, and confirmed server events open by verified event ID.
Reloading the server setup invalidates the UI event-list load marker. An empty cleared cache is not presented as a confirmed empty Discord server; only an actual empty response shows no events.
A storage failure preserves the title, poll and chosen image, keeps the confirmation reviewable, and performs zero native operation sends.
Migration preserves the old accent, archived image and read-only history. An active v1 duty can pause/resume/finish locally while logged out, with zero operation sends and zero image deletions.

A non-manager cannot edit the configured role. Category-specific channel permissions and missing event permissions disable the matching action with the actual reason; role mention never promises private visibility.
Browser preview has no fake login/upload/send success. All five views, long target names and dialogs remain within the viewport at 320/390 px, with reachable navigation and action buttons.
